{{Top}}
The '''YG-series''' was a line of light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They were later followed by the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] of freighters (including such famous ships as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]) and the [[VCX series/Legends|VCX series]], which debuted around the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
